reasoning_content: Both boards and CMS are running on 711MB. Next is the app — the heaviest one. This build has a warm file cache (from the last attempt, the app build progressed quite far). Risk: the app's build (about 1.5–2GB) + CMS (about 1GB) + boards (about 1GB) + containers (about 2.5GB) ≈ 6.5–7GB vs. 7.6GB. It's a tight call, but since the file cache is warm, I'm going to give it a try.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=app < /dev/zero' > /tmp/g3.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "app UP check $i"; break; }
  sleep 45
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p'
